exact_holds.description: TIA/EIA-422-B original and EMC/EMI practices unexamined.
Physical arming, emission mode, gimbal safety switch is not software CSAPI Command/ack.
NEZ maps, installed turret, location and suppression state not observed.
Purge 30ms physical switch provision; no actual erase command/event.
J3 SMPTE/RS170a originals and figure/modality matrix unverified.
J4 external IEEE/SMPTE/MIL-PRF/ARINC/ISO specs and full figure geometry unread.
J4 source prints Rreceive and 25GBAASE inconsistencies; preserve literal source standing.
J5 antenna conditional; no actual GNSS fix/time inferred.
J6 original MIL-STD704F and MIL-STD1310 text unreviewed.
J6 separate repeated Rule13.5.2.7.1-4 and -5 post-inrush constraints retained.
J6 Recommendation13.5.2.7.1-1 prints Inspection(I) and -2 prints none; both SHOULD.
J6 Observation13.5.2.7.1-2 prints Inspection(I); remains Observation.
No physical measurements confirm 25A/2s, 15A, 1MΩ or 0.1Ω design conditions.
J3/J4 video physical signal channels do not establish video frame or CSAPI DataStream.
J2 1 PPS ICD-GPS-060B companion and actual time-quality unverified.
Four original figure images and dense table modality checkmark pixels not verified.
Eight C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI, later S251, and restricted Appendix C remain held.
No four source cases independently prove J2–J6 SOSA implementation.
No DIM/Profile class, SHALL, actual device control or runtime conformance adopted.
